title: Kondekor language
description: Central Dravidian language spoken in India
extract: The Kondekor language (IPA: [koɳɖekoːr] is a Central Dravidian language. A closely related variety is Ollari. The two have been treated either as dialects, or as separate languages. They are spoken in and around Pottangi, Koraput district, Odisha and in Srikakulam District, Andhra Pradesh, India.
